title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

projects.name: Ship of Harkinian (SoH)
projects.description: Port nativo mais maduro do N64. Oferece altas taxas de quadros interpoladas, widescreen, DX11/OpenGL/Metal, Randomizer extensivo (Master Quest, Enemy Randomizer), modos Speedrun, multiplayer online via Anchor, cosméticos, save states e mods .o2r/.otr.
projects.requirements: Extrair o ZIP, executar soh.exe e fornecer ROM suportada (verificável em ship.equipment) para gerar oot.o2r automaticamente.
